svg.title: Model Dockerfile to registry to shem
svg.desc: Hugging Face supplies model checkpoints to shem's BuildKit frontend. docker build produces a linux/riscv32 OCI image containing the model weights, tokenizer and optional session state. docker push and pull exchange it with an ordinary registry, such as Docker Hub or GHCR. docker run selects io.containerd.shem.v1 and starts a Python/PyTorch model session through the shem shim.
